name: blacksheep
description: Black Sheep — the news layer for AI agents. Source-linked equity and crypto headlines, change monitoring, MCP and REST.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @blacksheep/api && npm run build -w blacksheep-worker && npm run build -w blacksheep-web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @blacksheep/contracts && npm run build -w @blacksheep/db
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w blacksheep-worker && npm run build -w @blacksheep/api && node --test packages/contracts/dist/*.test.js packages/db/dist/*.test.js apps/worker/dist/*.test.js apps/worker/dist/*.test.js apps/api/dist/lib/*.test.js && node --test apps/web/tests/*.test.mjs
